name: skill-tooling
description: Opt-in skill-authoring tools from NVIDIA (standard policy only, never restricted): skillevaluator (run and read SkillEvaluator benchmarks of a SKILL.md; needs the skillevaluator CLI, Python 3.12-3.14, and Docker plus an LLM key for live runs) and skill-inspector (review a skill before installing it with SkillSpector). The kit installs neither CLI.
